LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-3.B
Calculate derivatives of 
products and quotients of 
differentiable functions.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-3.B.2
Derivatives of quotients of differentiable 
functions can be found using the quotient rule.

FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.
